## Où j'en suis
The dashboard grid is built behind the `dashboards_v2` flag: drag and resize, with the layout saved per user through `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` and a localStorage fallback. Container queries were replaced by a ResizeObserver hook so widgets resize on iOS 15, `DashboardTile` was renamed `WidgetCard`, and the Storybook build is fixed. Draft PR #418 is open.

- [en-cours] Priya's UX review on iPad (BrowserStack, iOS 15.7) before the Zest demo
- [prochaine-étape] Enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace in the flags admin before the demo on Tuesday 24th
- [essai-raté] Container queries: iOS 15 Safari ignores `@container` rules silently, so widgets never resized on Zest's iPads
- [décision] Drop container queries and use the ResizeObserver hook, to avoid two sizing systems (source: t09)
- [décision] Keep the v1 dashboards behind the flag until January and remove nothing now (source: t15)
- [décision] Rename `DashboardTile` to `WidgetCard` everywhere (source: t11)
